claims.evidence: No origin markings, labels, or import stickers visible in either photo; plastic wrap obscures body.
No audio/video evidence; photos are static and show no power-on or speaker test.
Report notes 'working condition / power-on test' and 'functioning of keys' are not shown.
No adapter visible in either photo; only the wrapped keyboard body is shown.
Requires audio/functional test not present in the two static photos.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have dead keys/non-working buttons
risks.proof: A video clip of the seller powering it on and pressing a range of keys top to bottom, including all buttons/dials.

risks.risk: No adapter may actually be included despite claim
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter laid next to the keyboard, with cable and plug visible.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (scratches, dents, cracked casing) under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos with the plastic wrap removed, showing all sides and the full keybed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unknown/worst-case cosmetic condition

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model means no price tier can be fixed beyond generic 'keyboard'
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the brand logo and model number/sticker on the back or near the control panel.

risks.risk: Full key count and speaker presence/condition unclear
risks.proof: A straight-on full-length photo showing the entire keybed and speaker grilles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as smallest common key-count variant with unverified speakers

proof_requests: Video of power-on test with keys and buttons being pressed across full range
Photo of the adapter/cable included with the unit
Unwrapped photos from all sides showing casing condition
Close-up of brand/model label or logo
Full-length straight shot showing entire keybed and speakers
response.reason: The item type (electronic keyboard) is settled by the witness, but brand, functionality, adapter presence, and cosmetic condition are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
